title: Storybound story event
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/events/<path>.json — when the trigger fires and the conditions pass, run the actions.

icon.description: Dev mode only: the item this node shows on the editor's canvases (an item id, e.g. minecraft:compass). The game does not read it; without it, the kind's own item.

on_fail.description: abort: stop at a failed action (an aborted 'once' event may run again). continue: log and run the rest.

once.description: Run only once per this scope. Absent means every time.
